description:
Scholarship overview

NTU's Research Scholarship supports eligible PhD researchers in Singapore. Selection is linked to the admitting school and research programme, so applicants must use the relevant school deadline. Stipend rates depend on citizenship and stage of candidature.

Research Areas

  • Eligible NTU research subjects
  • Doctoral research
  • Research training

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryInternational: SGD 3,000/month (2026); qualifying-exam increment up to SGD 500

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsCitizens and permanent residents have different stipend rates; check school intake.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusProgramme-dependent
Deadline / consideration roundSchool/programme-specific; no single university deadline
LocationSingapore

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

NTU offers research degrees through its schools in Singapore. Its research scholarships support eligible graduate researchers, with stipend rates, admission deadlines and selection managed under the relevant programme.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
